Name: Earthy Seasonal Leaf Cursor
Author: S4iS3i
Description:
[center][img]https://imgur.com/voYUfwl.png[/img]


[b]This mod recolors the Seasonal Leaf Cursor by GalaxyRobot to fit with [b]the color palette from [b]Earthy Recolour by DaisyNiko[/b][/b]
[/b]Each seasons color tones are taken from the leaf and tree textures from Earthy Recolour. 
The menu cursor set is changed to be neutral in coloring without any vines or decorations.
[b]
Compared to the original mod various other changes were made.[/b]
The hourglass and looking glass transparency is changed and the sand and flower within has been colored to fit with each season.
The healing symbol matches with summer tones. The heart symbol matches with fall tones.
Added vines and snow on the arrow cursors and the looking glass handle. For winter also added snow cover on the healing and heart symbol.
Matched the outline on the hands, gift and chat bubble icons with the rest. Added dual tone text on the chat bubble.
And various smaller changes were done to unify all the cursors more with each other.

[b]There are 2 variants to pick from.[/b]
Variant 1 keeps the healing and heart symbol the same across each season in default colors.
Variant 2 recolors the healing and heart symbols to fit with each season.
You can look at the pictures for a nice comparison.


[img]https://imgur.com/FHCpZcr.png[/img]


[b]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16760?tab=description]Seasonal Leaf Cursor[/url]﻿ with a mod manager or manually.[/b]
Overwrite with this mod.
[b]
If there are any questions, just ask in the comments.
[/b]I'll try and help if I can.
